mapper.select: SELECT crs.cap_rule_set_id AS capRuleSetId, crs.policy_version_id AS policyVersionId, crs.payment_stage AS paymentStage, crs.contract_date_from AS contractDateFrom, crs.contract_date_to AS contractDateTo, crs.insurer_id AS insurerId, crs.product_group_code AS productGroupCode, crs.channel_code AS channelCode, crs.first_year_months AS firstYearMonths, crs.premium_multiplier AS premiumMultiplier, crs.compliance_deduction_pct AS complianceDeductionPct, crs.refund_addition_condition AS refundAdditionCondition, crs.warning_usage_pct AS warningUsagePct FROM fgc.cap_rule_set crs JOIN fgc.policy_version pv ON pv.policy_version_id = crs.policy_version_id WHERE pv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND crs.contract_date_from <= #{asOfDate} AND (crs.contract_date_to IS NULL OR crs.contract_date_to >= #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY crs.payment_stage, crs.cap_rule_set_id

SELECT rrt.refund_rate_table_id AS refundRateTableId, rrt.policy_version_id AS policyVersionId, pv.version_no AS versionNo, rrt.standard_deduction_80_yn AS standardDeduction80Yn, rrt.effective_from AS effectiveFrom FROM fgc.refund_rate_table rrt JOIN fgc.policy_version pv ON pv.policy_version_id = rrt.policy_version_id WHERE pv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rrt.effective_from <= #{asOfDate} AND (rrt.effective_to IS NULL OR rrt.effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY rrt.refund_rate_table_id

SELECT product_offering_id AS productOfferingId, product_id AS productId, channel_code AS channelCode, fee_regime_code AS feeRegimeCode, standard_deduction_80_yn AS standardDeduction80Yn FROM fgc.product_offering WHERE active_yn = true AND sales_start_date <= #{asOfDate} AND (sales_end_date IS NULL OR sales_end_date >= #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY product_offering_id
